sources.title: franckverrot/vovo · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Vovo is an English text-to-speech model built from scratch in Swift with hand-written Metal kernels — its own tensor engine, autograd, optimizer, data pipeline and trainer. This 20 M-parameter single-speaker voice was trained on LJSpeech in about 13 minutes on an M2 Max.
